dedupe_keys.name: mexico inventory of federal and parastatal real estate indaabin

description: Instituto de Administración y Avalúos de Bienes Nacionales (INDAABIN), Mexico publishes the inventory of the federal and parastatal real estate of Mexico kept by INDAABIN, the institute that administers and appraises national property, covering government buildings and other federal properties; the portal tags include government building, federal property and infrastructure. Coverage: Mexico nationwide; the portal record was created and last modified on 2026-06-26, and the CSV is served from the agency data repository. Format and access: CSV, downloadable without registration from the Mexican open data portal (datos.gob.mx); the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; cost: free. Caveats: the portal description is one line, so the number of properties, the attribute fields and whether coordinates are included were not read. Simulation uses: exposure of federal government buildings and land to hazards, continuity planning of public services, and building-stock counts for national risk models. Related catalogue records: OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
